{{Quote|Battle stations please, gentlebeings.''"<br />"''Battle stations? On a yacht? I have a bad feeling about this!|Siene Symm and a member of Green squad|<ref name="Godking">{{WEGCite|story=Tests of the Godking|book=Star Wars Campaign Pack}}</ref>}}
'''Siene Symm''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] swindler. Apprehended by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and sentenced to hard labor, Symm used the [[Time/Legends|time]] to hone several skills related to the job of a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]]. He also gained a hatred for the Empire. Once free, Symm joined [[Reekeene's Roughnecks]], a [[Alliance Military/Legends|military]] unit of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. He became the co-pilot of the customized [[Yacht/Legends|yacht]] ''[[Long Shot]]'', under the command of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Ixsthmus]], with whom Symm became friends.

The Sullustan helmed the ''Long Shot'' during several missions from [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]] onward, many of which included carrying other teams of the Roughnecks to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] where they would perform a different mission. In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], while taking the Roughnecks' [[Green squad]] to [[Abonshee]], Symm's shift was interrupted by an attack by a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] named [[Jayhawk]]. The ''Long Shot'' was able to survive the encounter, and Symm saw later action on [[Alabash]] and [[Iyuta]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Red alert, guys. Imperial vessels entering the atmosphere. Looks like it's going to land. If we're to get out before they spot us we've got to leave now&mdash;can't wait for you to get back to the ship. Better stay hidden until we come back with reinforcements, or they leave. They'll be within scanning distance shortly. Good luck. Symm out.|Siene Symm|<ref name="Godking" />}}
The [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] Siene Symm, [[Homeworld/Legends|hailing]] from [[Sullust/Legends|Sullust]], was a professional cheat, a sly deceiver, and a qualified counterfeiter. However, he was eventually caught and sent to an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Warship/Legends|warship]] to perform labor. During this time, Symm brushed up his skills to use and repair [[Starship/Legends|starship]] technology, and also developed firm anti-Imperial ideas. He remained captive for several [[Time/Legends|years]] before gaining his freedom. Wanting to do his part in defeating the Empire, Symm then became a member of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. Around [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], he was chosen to [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] the modified [[GX1 short hauler/Legends|GX1 Short Hauler]] ''[[Long Shot]]'', under [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Ixsthmus]]. Symm and Ixsthmus were the only organic crew of the ship, although two [[Droid/Legends|droids]], [[R2-V0]] and [[Four-Onebee]], had been assigned to the craft, which commonly ferried Rebel [[Squad/Legends|squads]] to [[Planet/Legends|planets]] to perform a variety of missions. The ''Long Shot'' had been assigned to [[Reekeene's Roughnecks]], an irregular partisan group of the Alliance under the command of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Lens Reekeene]].<ref name="CP" />

In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], the ''Long Shot'' was chosen to take the recently commissioned [[Green squad]] of Roughnecks to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Abonshee|Masterhome]] to open diplomatic relations with the native population. While Ixsthmus reported the situation, Symm took the controls and piloted the ship. En route, they were intercepted by the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] ship ''[[Martinette]]'', commanded by a Captain [[Jayhawk]]. After the Rebels managed to defeat the self-proclaimed [[Privateer/Legends|privateers]], Symm took the ship to Masterhome. Both Symm and Ixsthmus remained on-board during the negotiations, which would be performed by Green squad.<ref name="Godking" />

This allowed Symm to later identify an approaching Imperial ship, the [[Curich-class shuttle|''Curich''-class shuttle]] [[Resurgence (Curich-class)|''Resurgence'']]. If the Imperials saw the ''Long Shot'' at their arrival at Masterhome, they would identify it as a Rebel ship. Ixsthmus ordered Symm to leave even before Green squad could board again. Symm warned Green squad of the situation through a [[Comlink/Legends|communicator]], promised them that he would return with reinforcements, and advised them to lay low in the meantime. The ''Long Shot'' rendezvoused with two Roughneck [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wings]] and returned to Masterhome to rescue Green squad if needed. The situation ended with the Imperials defeated and Masterhome joining the Alliance.<ref name="Godking" />

Symm served the Roughnecks in other missions, including [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] service to the [[Volcano/Legends|volcanic]] world [[Alabash]]<ref name="Freedom">{{WEGCite|story=The Heat of Freedom|book=Star Wars Campaign Pack}}</ref> and a watch of the communication center of [[Iyuta]] that also required avoiding several custom [[Officer/Legends|officers]]. During the latter mission, Symm spent the time playing [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] with other Rebels and won some [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|money]]. Also during this mission, Symm and the others aboard the ''Long Shot'' discovered that General Reekeene had been captured by Imperial forces and sent to the planet [[Flankers]], whose [[Star/Legends|sun]] would go [[Nova/Legends|nova]] in only hours. In order to save her, the crew of the ''Long Shot'' went to Flankers. Symm piloted the ''Long Shot'' and fought the Imperials' [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] and air defenses. Later, a squad was sent to the planetary surface so they could rescue Reekeene; Symm kept them informed about the time they had left before the nova.<ref name="Missing">{{WEGCite|story=Lens Reekeene Is Missing|book=Star Wars Campaign Pack}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
Siene Symm was a hard-working co-pilot, professional and competent. He developed several skills related to [[Realspace/Legends|space]] [[Transport/Legends|transports]], including piloting, repairs, and using their weapons and communications. He once attempted to use his abilities to repair the droid R2-V0, believing that it was making strange noises due to a defect. Symm, who did not notice that R2-V0 was attempting to create [[Poet/Legends|poetry]], was unable to stop the droid from continuing. Symm also retained talents from his less-than-legal days, such as his forgery abilities and [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]] skills, which allowed him to earn some of his peers' money. As an officer in the Rebel Alliance, Symm commonly carried a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]].<ref name="CP" />

Symm was a happy worker who enjoyed traveling, piloting, and being with other people. Friendly, although still a con, he developed a false persona of naivety to hide his own skills. Symm was also a bon vivant, wearing pretentious clothes and tasting exotic food and [[Drilbian wine]]. His cabin aboard the ''Long Shot'' was more opulent than the Captain's. Symm used [[red]] lights and heavy [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] in his cabin to replicate the conditions of his native planet, Sullust, something that was disliked by non-Sullustan visitors. As of [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], Symm had served under Ixsthmus for one year, and both of them had became good friends, even though they had very different backgrounds.<ref name="CP" />

==Behind the scenes==
Siene Symm first appeared in ''[[Tests of the Godking]]'', a scenario for ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'', first published in the ''[[Star Wars Campaign Pack]]'' in [[1988]] and then reprinted along with other material in [[1994]] in ''[[Classic Campaigns]]''.
